text:
Marta: Hey team — urgent coverage gap for tonight's EU overnight (02:00-06:00 UTC). I'm tied up with a family emergency and can't take primary. Primary was supposed to be Leo, secondary Devon. Can someone pick up primary or shadow? Customers on dedicated capacity might see higher latencies if we get a pager. :pray:

Devon: I can cover shadow/secondary for the first half (02:00-04:00 UTC), but I have a calendar block 04:00-05:30 (APAC call). Not sure I can stay full primary.

Oncall Bot: AUTO ALERT: There is currently no confirmed primary for shift 2026-03-15 02:00-06:00 UTC. Pager routing will escalate to on-call rotation fallback after 2 minutes. See: https://redwood-internal/rota (please claim).

Leo: Sorry team — I just realized I have a time overlap with a partner call at 03:15 that I can't move. I can take first 02:00-03:30 if that helps, but can't be full shift.

Marta: Thanks. We're aiming for contiguous coverage. If we have staggered handoffs, document the handover in #eng-oncall at the swap time. Key runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference/night-ops.md (check "latency surge" and "fallback routing").

Anika: I can step in as primary for 03:30-06:00 UTC if Leo covers 02:00-03:30 and Devon does 02:00-04:00 shadow. I'll be remote but available. Quick note: if latency spike hits >500ms p50 for dedicated customers, follow runbook step 2 -> scale dedicated pool and enable fallback-variant model.

Devon: OK I'll do 02:00-04:00 shadow and assist with escalations. Can someone patch the rota so Oncall Bot stops sending auto-escalate? Don't want PD noise.

SRE Rotation Bot: COMMANDS:
```
# claim shift as primary
rota claim --team eng-inference --start 2026-03-15T02:00Z --end 2026-03-15T06:00Z --user Devon
# set shadow
rota shadow --team eng-inference --start 2026-03-15T02:00Z --end 2026-03-15T04:00Z --user Leo
```
(Use web UI if you prefer: https://redwood-internal/rota/claim)

Marta: Devon — if you claim primary briefly, please include these items in your handoff note: active model variants, any in-progress canary rollouts, current batch sizes, and KV cache hit rate. Example heading: "02:00-04:00 primary (Devon) — model: redwood/gpt-xxl-quant, batches: 128, kv_hit: 72%"

Leo: I'll take 02:00-03:30 primary then mark in rota. Devon, if you need me past 03:30 I can extend but need a heads-up 20m prior.

Anika: Also ping support-ops if any customer-facing incidents are opened — they'll help with public status and customer comms. If you need to throttle dedicated customers, adjust route weights in console: console.redwood.internal -> Traffic -> Routes -> weight fallback.

Devon: Claimed primary for 02:00-04:00 in rota (done). Leaving a handoff note: "02:00-04:00 primary (Devon) — model: redwood/gpt-xxl-quant v2, batches: 64-128 dynamic, kv_hit: 70%, canary: none."

Oncall Bot: UPDATE: Claim recorded. Pager escalation delay removed for the claimed window. Automatic escalate will resume at 06:00 UTC.

Marta: Amazing — thank you all. Two quick reminders: 1) If a paging storm starts, call the emergency bridge (tel:+1-555-0202) and add #incidents. 2) If you're handing off mid-shift, paste the short checklist from the runbook into #eng-oncall. I'll check in later this evening. :heart:

Leo: Copy that. I'll post the 03:30 handoff note in the channel 10m before swap.

Anika: I'll stand by for any customer comms and can help push a status update if we see degradation. Good luck everyone. :headphones:
